tagline: 美能达旁轴相机，1969 年发布
description: 美能达于1969年推出的旁轴相机。配备Rokkor 1:2.8/38mm 4-element glass。快门速度speeds 1/45 sec. in flash mode, otherwise 1/90 sec.。使用126 film cartridge。

specs.取景器: bright frame finder with coupled rangefinder
specs.快门: speeds 1/45 sec. in flash mode, otherwise 1/90 sec.
specs.光圈: automatically controlled by CdS light sensor over the lens
specs.英文简介: In 1969, when Neil Armstrong set foot on the Moon, there was a great demand for easy-to-use cameras on Earth that may have been set off some years earlier by Kodak's 126 film cartridge system.
